name: Ways to Change
source:
This is a story about a person becoming an adult, in a hostile environment where the hate to inmigrants become more present. Be a student that, not only has to face all the problems of being himself, but also everything that comes with being an inmigrant in an other country, it was his choice, will he stick to it?

In this game every decision matters. Every silence, every goodbye, every act of courage or fear shapes who you become and influences the people around you.

Explore a world where growing up means facing what hurts, and where strength is born from vulnerability, face the challenges of your situation and clarify the line between helping the world and helping yourself. Connect with the people around you and find the faces of being an inmigrant

[From [url=https://snufbel.itch.io/ways-to-change]Itch.io[/url]]
